_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_paige: Wren's Story

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Jack. I want to tell you about Wren.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I haven't spoken his name out loud in two years.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: He was a militia volunteer. Stubborn. Kind. Terrible at cooking.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: He died defending a supply convoy from marauders. Five years ago.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I threw myself into building this Archive. To avoid... everything.

options.text: Thank you for trusting me with this.
He'd be proud of what you've built.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: He would say 'Paige, the books aren't going anywhere. Go LIVE.'

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: He was always right about the important things.
